chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who wraps himself in a single garment. He said: 'If he covers his private part, there is no problem.'

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no problem / it is permissible
key_terms.يَحْتَبِي: wraps himself / covers himself with a garment

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray wearing only one piece of cloth?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Imam al-Sadiq (AS) through the chain of Samaan al-Ash'ari, this hadith establishes the fundamental principle that the validity of prayer depends on the adequacy of covering the 'awrah' rather than the number of garments. This ruling reflects the practical flexibility in Shia fiqh, allowing for simplicity in worship while maintaining the essential requirement of modesty and ritual purity.
